classification: ROM-derived boss animation structures; decoded assemblies have separate pose/position validation

format.tail_field_labels: unresolved; bytes +8/+9 are consumed by interaction dispatch

routine_evidence.note: The animation updater reads duration and flags, advances by 16 bytes, and follows a long backward pointer when flags are negative. The flags word at offset +2 splits into flip_x (bit 15), a 7-bit sequence index, and an 8-bit parameter byte. The tail is not an X/Y word pair: bytes +8 and +9 index interaction tables.

remaining_gate: Boss: all 28 pose assemblies are in the pose/position gate; the 5 no-oracle trace assemblies (mid-attack transients + at-rest sibling) are decoded but not pixel-verifiable. Next: extract the player, street-aliens and Stalker programs, resolve record-selection timing and the transient position settling observation, and label the unresolved tail fields and actor-local hitboxes.
